sources.narrative1: This workstation serves as a real-time vector rendering engine for line-based diplomatic transcriptions adhering to the strict format guidelines established by the Hispanic Seminary of Medieval Studies (HSMS).
sources.narrative2: By mapping raw inline diacritic strings, environment codes, and spatial annotations to precise coordinate vector metrics, it replicates the physical nature of historical manuscript layout architectures.
sources.fundingBlurb: This project is funded by Georgetown University and developed under the direction of Michael J. Ferreira.
sources.georgetownDesc: Research funding supporting this transcription workstation.
sources.ferreiraDesc: Project direction, Hispanic Seminary of Medieval Studies.
sources.ostaCitationDesc: Gago Jover & Pueyo Mena, Old Spanish Textual Archive (HSMS). Cite work ids (HSMS-…) and include query filters when publishing results.
sources.ostaSyntaxDesc: Fields: word, lemma, pos (EAGLES). Wildcards: . .* .+ ? * + ; gaps [] ; classes [abc] / [^x]. See docs/OSTA-guide.md.
sources.ostaProoferDesc: Studio flags technical, editorial, and structural incidents only — Proofer señala; el editor decide. MCP: audit_hsms_syntax.

copilot.recipe.abbr.nasal_tilde_vs_gemin: Counted words whose diplomatic surface matches n~/ñ, nn, nh or ny (graph set palatal_nasal), by quire.
copilot.recipe.abbr.expansion_by_quire.a: {forms, plural, one {# abbreviated form} other {# abbreviated forms}} compared across {quires, plural, one {# quire} other {# quires}}.
copilot.recipe.abbr.expansion_by_quire.m: Expansion tokens <…> grouped by expanded reading form, compared with the same form written out in full, first half vs second half of the quires.
{total, plural, one {# place where an editorial insertion immediately follows a scribal deletion.} other {# places where an editorial insertion immediately follows a scribal deletion.}}
Lines where a scribal deletion (^…) is immediately followed by an editorial insertion […]. Transposition notation is not tokenized yet.
{joined, plural, one {# divided word joined across a column or folio boundary} other {# divided words joined across a column or folio boundary}}; {violations, plural, one {# column ending on a bare hyphen} other {# columns ending on a bare hyphen}}; {lineInternal, plural, one {# line-end hyphen inside columns} other {# line-end hyphens inside columns}}.

copilot.recipe.chars.accents.answer: {total, plural, one {# orthographic accent mark} other {# orthographic accent marks}} across {sections, plural, one {# language section} other {# language sections}}.
copilot.recipe.chars.accents.method: Legacy accent notation @' (acute), @` (grave), @^ (circumflex), @# (dieresis) counted per language section.
copilot.recipe.chars.numerals_symbols.an: {roman, plural, one {# Roman numeral bounded by periods} other {# Roman numerals bounded by periods}}, {symb, plural, one {# {SYMB.} symbol} other {# {SYMB.} symbols}} and {formulas, plural, one {# Greek-letter formula} other {# Greek-letter formulas}}.

copilot.recipe.figure.interior_text.answ: {total, plural, one {# figure with interior text.} other {# figures with interior text.}}
copilot.recipe.figure.interior_text.meth: Figure anchors {MIN.}/{DIAG.}/{ILL.} with non-empty text, plus {DIAG.} blocks containing words.
copilot.recipe.phon.sibilants.method: Intervocalic -s- vs -ss-, and ç/c' vs z, on diplomatic surfaces outside foreign-language spans.
copilot.recipe.phon.palatal_nasal.method: Graph set palatal_nasal (n~/ñ, nn, nh, ny). Plain-n spellings need a lemma list and are not counted.
copilot.recipe.phon.palatal_lateral.meth: Graph set palatal_lateral (ll, li + vowel, lh). li + vowel is noisy: read the examples.
copilot.recipe.phon.apocope.answer: {pairs, plural, one {# stem attested both with and without final -e} other {# stems attested both with and without final -e}}: {apocopated} apocopated vs {full} full forms.
copilot.recipe.phon.apocope.method: Word types ending in -e whose form without -e is also attested (noche / noch).
copilot.recipe.morph.enclisis.answer: {enclitic, plural, one {# enclitic form} other {# enclitic forms}} (verb+pronoun as one word) vs {proclitic, plural, one {# proclitic form} other {# proclitic forms}} for the same verbs.
copilot.recipe.morph.enclisis.method: Words = verb stem + enclitic where the bare stem also occurs alone; proclitic = clitic word followed by that stem.
copilot.recipe.morph.enclisis.server: Splitting main from subordinate clauses needs syntactic parsing.
copilot.recipe.morph.clitic_elision.answ: {merged, plural, one {# merged form} other {# merged forms}} vs {separate, plural, one {# separate form} other {# separate forms}}.
copilot.recipe.morph.clitic_elision.meth: Closed list of elided clitic forms (yl, quel, nol…) vs their two-word counterparts.
copilot.recipe.morph.contractions.answer: {merged, plural, one {# merged form} other {# merged forms}} vs {separate, plural, one {# separate form} other {# separate forms}}.
copilot.recipe.morph.contractions.method: Closed list of merged preposition+article/pronoun forms per witness language vs the separate two-word forms.
copilot.recipe.morph.prefix_separation.a: {total, plural, one {# prefixed compound marked with [+]} other {# prefixed compounds marked with [+]}}, {prefixes, plural, one {# distinct prefix} other {# distinct prefixes}}.
copilot.recipe.morph.prefix_linebreak.an: {total, plural, one {# line ending with a prefix separated from its root ([+]-).} other {# lines ending with a prefix separated from its root ([+]-).}}
copilot.recipe.morph.prefix_linebreak.me: Lines whose last tokens are [+] followed by a line-end hyphen.
copilot.recipe.lex.latinate_doublets.ans: {learned, plural, one {# learned (Latinate) spelling} other {# learned (Latinate) spellings}} vs {vernacular, plural, one {# vernacular spelling} other {# vernacular spellings}} across {doublets, plural, one {# doublet} other {# doublets}}; {expanded, plural, one {# abbreviated learned form} other {# abbreviated learned forms}}.
copilot.recipe.lex.latinate_doublets.met: Closed list of learned/vernacular doublets plus abbreviated learned spellings (ct, pt, mn, gn) expanded by the editor.
copilot.recipe.lex.greek_formulas.answer: {total, plural, one {# Greek-letter formula (xp-/ih-) with ±5 words of context.} other {# Greek-letter formulas (xp-/ih-) with ±5 words of context.}}
copilot.recipe.lex.greek_formulas.method: Words beginning xp- or ih[s/u]- on the diplomatic surface, with ±5 words of context.
copilot.recipe.dial.tagged_spans.answer: {total, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} with tagged Iberian dialect or language spans ({codes, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}}).
copilot.recipe.dial.tagged_spans.method: Lines containing editor-tagged Iberian language spans ({ARG.}, {CAT.}, {GAL.}, {PRT.}, {BAS.}).
copilot.recipe.dial.tagged_spans.server: Detecting untagged dialect features needs a feature classifier.
copilot.recipe.aljamiado.symb_spans.answ: {total, plural, one {# {SYMB.} span} other {# {SYMB.} spans}} ({words, plural, one {# transliterated word} other {# transliterated words}}).
copilot.recipe.aljamiado.symb_spans.meth: {SYMB.} figure anchors with their transliterated text and Romance context.
copilot.recipe.aljamiado.symb_spans.serv: Mapping Romance phonemes onto Arabic or Hebrew characters needs the transliteration model.
copilot.recipe.syntax.punctuation.answer: {total, plural, one {# punctuation mark} other {# punctuation marks}} of {kinds, plural, one {# kind} other {# kinds}}, split by line position.
copilot.recipe.syntax.punctuation.method: Punctuation marks (. : ; , / ¶ and scribal $; $.) counted by line-final vs internal position.
copilot.recipe.syntax.punctuation.server: Aligning marks with clause boundaries needs syntactic parsing.
copilot.recipe.discourse.calderones.answ: {total, plural, one {# calderón} other {# calderóns}} (% {single}, %2 {two}, %3 {three}); {nearSpeech} introduce reported speech within six words.
copilot.recipe.discourse.calderones.meth: Calderón tokens %, %2, %3 with the following words; a speech verb within six words marks a probable turn (heuristic).
copilot.recipe.stats.ttr_hapax.answer: {tokens} tokens, {types} types: TTR {ttr}, STTR/1000 {sttr}, {hapax} hapax and {dis} dis legomena. Raw TTR falls as texts grow; compare witnesses with STTR.
copilot.recipe.stats.ttr_hapax.method: Body-text word forms (accents folded): TTR, STTR over 1,000-token windows, hapax and dis legomena, per quire.
copilot.recipe.stats.ttr_hapax.registry: {witnesses, plural, one {Type-token statistics for # witness in the batch (STTR per 1,000 tokens).} other {Type-token statistics for # witnesses in the batch (STTR per 1,000 tokens).}}
copilot.recipe.stats.top_lemmas.method: HSMS dictionary lemmas (surface forms until it loads), minus the witness-language stopword list.
copilot.recipe.stats.top_lemmas.surfaceF: Top {top} word forms (lemma dictionary still loading) excluding function words.
copilot.recipe.stats.variant_share.answe: {total, plural, one {# occurrence} other {# occurrences}} of “{lemma}” in {spellings, plural, one {# spelling} other {# spellings}}.
copilot.recipe.stats.variant_share.metho: Forms whose dictionary lemma matches, or whose orthographic skeleton (ç/z, ss/s, ff/f, v/u, y/i folded) matches the lemma.
copilot.recipe.stats.zipf.answer: Zipf slope {slope} over the top {points} types (≈ −1 is typical of natural text).
copilot.recipe.stats.zipf.method: Least-squares slope of log10(frequency) on log10(rank) over the 200 most frequent word forms.
copilot.recipe.colloc.window.answer: {collocates, plural, one {# collocate} other {# collocates}} of “{word}” within ±{window} words (ranked by log-likelihood; pairs seen fewer than {min} times are dropped because PMI overrates rare pairs).
copilot.recipe.colloc.window.method: Co-occurrence within ±window words (stopwords excluded): PMI, t-score and log-likelihood G²; minimum 3 co-occurrences.
copilot.recipe.ngrams.top.answer: Top {count} recurring {n}-grams (sequences made only of function words skipped; none cross a folio break).
copilot.recipe.ngrams.top.method: Contiguous word sequences within each folio side; sequences made only of function words are skipped.
copilot.recipe.colloc.prep_article.answe: "{prep}" + article: {merged} merged, {separate} separate; {zero} with no article.
copilot.recipe.colloc.prep_article.metho: The preposition followed by an article (merged or separate) vs followed by another word.
copilot.recipe.morph.subordinators.answe: {merged, plural, one {# merged subordinator} other {# merged subordinators}} vs {separate, plural, one {# separate subordinator} other {# separate subordinators}}.
copilot.recipe.morph.subordinators.metho: Closed list of complex subordinators written as one unit vs split.
copilot.recipe.morph.prefix_productivity: {total, plural, one {# prefixed compound marked with [+]} other {# prefixed compounds marked with [+]}}, {prefixes, plural, one {# distinct prefix} other {# distinct prefixes}}.
[+] compounds counted by prefix; semantic domains need server processing.
Grouping prefixed verbs by semantic domain needs a lexical database.
copilot.recipe.codex.catchword_hyphen_bi: Hyphenated at quire feet {footRate}% ({footHyph}/{footTotal}) vs internal lines {innerRate}% ({innerHyph}/{innerTotal}); G² = {g2}, p = {p}.
2×2 table (folio-final line on a catchword page vs internal line × hyphenated) with log-likelihood G² and p-value; warns when expected counts < 5.
Expected counts below 5: treat this result with caution.

copilot.recipe.marg.vocab_ratio.method: Word types in {GL.} blocks vs body lines (accents folded): gloss-only types and Jaccard overlap.

copilot.recipe.compare.genre.answer: {witnesses, plural, one {# witness} other {# witnesses}} grouped {by, select, genre {by genre} other {by decade}}: lexical density and nn vs n~ ratio per group.
copilot.recipe.compare.genre.method: Batch witnesses grouped by genre metadata: lexical density and nn/(nn+n~).

copilot.recipe.compare.genre.server: Cross-corpus comparison over the full OSTA corpus runs on the server.
copilot.recipe.syntax.clitic_position.an: {enclitic, plural, one {# enclitic form} other {# enclitic forms}} (verb+pronoun as one word) vs {proclitic, plural, one {# proclitic form} other {# proclitic forms}} for the same verbs.
copilot.recipe.syntax.clitic_position.me: Needs POS tagging and clause parsing (server); local answer is the Tier B enclisis count.

copilot.recipe.ml.aljamiado_density.answ: {total, plural, one {# {SYMB.} span} other {# {SYMB.} spans}} ({words, plural, one {# transliterated word} other {# transliterated words}}).
copilot.recipe.ml.aljamiado_density.meth: Needs the Aljamiado lexicon (server); local answer lists the {SYMB.} spans.
copilot.recipe.ml.aljamiado_density.serv: Separating Romance vocabulary from Arabic or Hebrew loanwords inside transliterated spans needs the Aljamiado lexicon. Shown: the spans found locally.
copilot.recipe.stats.term_frequency.answ: Occurrences of “{word}”: {total, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} across {folios, plural, one {# folio} other {# folios}}.
